rationale: proxy-chain is a mature, production-grade HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxy server implementation (Apache-2.0, v3.0.1, maintained by Apify). It provides the core proxy infrastructure needed for stealth scraping: upstream proxy chaining with authentication, SOCKS4/5 support, TLS termination with cert validation control, custom responses for request interception, TCP tunneling via CONNECT, and connection pooling via custom HTTP/HTTPS agents. The library is used by Crawlee (popular Node.js crawling framework) and integrates directly with Puppeteer for headless Chrome proxy authentication. Source code shows thorough error handling (custom 590-599 status codes), byte-counting stats, IPv6 support, hop-by-hop header filtering, and comprehensive e2e test matrix covering HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS combinations with auth. Not a direct pipeline component but essential stealth infrastructure.
limitations: Not a scraping pipeline component itself - it's proxy infrastructure
No built-in fingerprinting, header normalization, or browser automation logic
Single-process Node.js; no clustering or horizontal scaling built-in
Basic Auth only for proxy authentication (no NTLM, Digest, OAuth)
No automatic proxy rotation or health checking
Architecture docs limited to README; no formal design documents
